rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something relating to industry or manufacturing.

example.english: These are industrial production lines, not for home use.
example.traditional: 呢啲係工業嘅生產線，唔係畀屋企用嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 hai6 gung1 jip6 ge3 sang1 caan2 sin3 m4 hai6 bei2 uk1 kei2 jung6 ge3

rows.note: Use this when describing a place or economy that has become industrialized or has many industries.

example.english: This former fishing village is now an industrial town.
example.traditional: 呢個以前係漁村，而家已經變成工業化嘅城鎮喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ji5 cin4 hai6 jyu4 cyun1 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 bin3 sing4 gung1 jip6 faa3 ge3 sing4 zan3 laa3
